name: designer-v2
source: Imitation seat (2026-11-09): Hard with the designer's recurring plays as genes, from docs/playtests/human-reasoning.md and the legatum-coach playbook. Early strike on an open neighbour (Sparta 8.8.1 T25, Aztecs 8.9.29 T42, India 8.9.25 T22); follow up city by city and pay through Walls for a prize; snipe exposed Settlers; focus fire; commit to the war he started; buy the decisive unit (Bomber after Flight); Walls on the frontier; expand hard while unthreatened.
